name: blinding-smoke-2026-10
note: A 12-run smoke test before the pilot: 3 papers x (blind, decoy) in the open lab x 2 replicates. It checks that the harness runs end to end on real models and gives a first look at decoy drift; it is not a result. Urban Land Cover and ROCKET have room to tune (seeds, splits, hyperparameters); pyts BOSS sits at 1.000, so its decoy is always lower. Same seed as the pilot, so each paper's decoy direction matches it. PDF paths starting with ~ are on the owner's machine.
